facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal (18 September 2025) puts RAPID-CI phase 1 at USD 160 million: USD 150 million IDA credit plus USD 10 million private capital mobilised, and it expects USD 310 million of private capital enabling in phase 1, the government being anchor client.

systems.country_label: Projet d'acceleration digitale en Cote d'Ivoire (PADCI)
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization

note: IDA loan to the state (USD 150 million, signed 17 October 2025) is money to the government, so no money/committed fact; the USD 10 million private capital is the state/brought fact.
